ambient/large.description: Ambient's own recommended default — the model id used in every example on the vendor's docs (the plain chat-completions curl example and the streaming curl example both send model: "ambient/large"). Documented as "an Ambient-managed alias rather than a distinct model. Its specs mirror whatever concrete model it currently points to" (https://ambient.xyz/docs/build/models, retrieved 2026-09-28); today it mirrors z-ai/glm-5.2 exactly — identical context_length, max_output_length and pricing in the unauthenticated GET https://api.ambient.xyz/v1/models response taken 2026-09-28. Text-only (input_modalities: ["text"]); no vision. The live roster's supported_features for this id are tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning, logprobs — this is the vendor's own server-reported metadata, not a live POST probe (none was possible credential-free), so capabilities.tools and capabilities.structuredOutput are marked true on that basis alone, while the combined capabilities (tools+response_format in one request, tool-call deltas under streaming) are unverified and both structuredOutputWithTools and toolsWithStreaming are left false pending a live-keyed probe. maxOutputTokens equals the context window in the vendor's own catalog entry (202,752 tokens each, i.e. "198K" as rounded on the docs models page).

z-ai/glm-5.2.description: The concrete underlying model that ambient/large currently aliases. The vendor's docs models page states "GLM 5.2 ... is the supported production model" (https://ambient.xyz/docs/build/models, retrieved 2026-09-28); other catalog ids may be previews with no guarantees. Text-only, no vision. Same live-roster numbers (unauthenticated GET https://api.ambient.xyz/v1/models, 2026-09-28) and the same unverified-combined-capability caveats as ambient/large — kept as a fallback pinned to a concrete id in case the ambient/large alias target changes underneath it.

qwen/qwen3.6-27b.description: Qwen3.6 27B. The live roster's input_modalities are ["text","image"] and the vendor's own description reads "natively multimodal (text + image) dense 27B, hybrid attention. Served FP8 at 32k context, thinking off." (unauthenticated GET https://api.ambient.xyz/v1/models, 2026-09-28). The vendor's docs models page marks non-GLM-5.2 entries as possible previews served with no guarantees, so status is preview here. vision: true is taken from input_modalities; set as models.visionModel since the default (ambient/large) is text-only. Same unverified-combined-capability caveats as the other entries (no live POST probe was possible).

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.description: Qwen3.8 27B. The live roster's own description calls it "natively multimodal (text + image + video) dense 27B, Apache 2.0, hybrid attention" but input_modalities lists only ["text","image"] — no "video" entry — so vision: true here is based on input_modalities, not the prose "video" claim, and no video-input support is declared. Same preview status and unverified-combined-capability caveats as qwen3.6-27b (unauthenticated GET https://api.ambient.xyz/v1/models, 2026-09-28).
